answer.brief_rationale: Lottery assignment independent of both potential outcomes, full compliance, positivity, consistency, and no interference identify the causal risk difference. The exact population risks are 1/10 under X=1 and 20/40 under X=0, yielding 0.1 − 0.5 = −0.4.
